Never mutated by successor experiments

Database and lane hashes verified

Deterministic TRAIN-only transforms
Seed and fold contracts are frozen
MPS-heavy execution serialized

nodes.label: Exp417 checkpoint store

constraints: Descriptor and inode checks
Atomic no-clobber publication

constraints: Deep immutable payloads
Lowercase SHA256 values
TRAIN-only evidence
Insufficient identity support produces explicit abstention

nodes.label: Exp425 DB snapshot
nodes.role: Pins and verifies a read-only SQLite snapshot and loads data through a held descriptor.
constraints: Expected database SHA required
Path/inode mutation rejected

nodes.label: Exp424 source validator
nodes.role: Authenticates Exp424 source descriptors, inspects 1,117 records and adapts valid nonterminal results.
constraints: Read-only descriptor-bound source
Fixed production compatibility contract

nodes.label: Exp425 checkpoint store
nodes.role: Owns imported/native record publication, import batches, progress, intent recovery and inspection.
constraints: One writable owner
Crash-safe atomic state machine

nodes.label: Exp426 contracts
nodes.role: Defines immutable provenance, dataset records, counts, progress and worker evidence for the verified baseline.
constraints: Exactly 12 workers in provenance
Imported and verified-abstention records remain distinct

nodes.label: Exp426 intake + 12 workers
nodes.role: Reads descriptor-bound Exp424 bytes, classifies them, and rechecks terminal datasets from TRAIN on a bounded twelve-process CPU pool.
constraints: Workers receive bytes or RawTrainDataset, never paths or database handles
Exactly 12 production workers with at most 24 prefetched tasks
No TEST value or label loader

nodes.label: Exp426 checkpoint
nodes.role: Creates, opens, inspects and commits Exp426 records against frozen provenance and context.
constraints: Parent-only writable store
Exact root inventory
Atomic intent and progress publication

nodes.label: Exp426 resumable runtime
nodes.role: Coordinates frozen-source intake, TRAIN-only terminal verification, parent-owned checkpoint commits, resumable interruption, immutable failure and self-written progress logs.
constraints: Exactly 12 CPU workers with bounded prefetch 24
Parent alone owns database, checkpoint and logs
No TEST value or label loader
Atomic progress, durable events and 30-second heartbeat
Interrupted roots resume with zero errors; failed roots are immutable
Failures persist a normalized exception type and message in progress, events and text log

nodes.label: Exp426 CLI + publication
nodes.role: Exposes frozen new, resume, inspect and readiness commands, binds new execution to same-commit readiness, and atomically publishes independently replayed label-free baseline artifacts.
constraints: Only frozen external roots are accepted
Runtime roots must be below a pre-existing parent isolated from the live database parent
No worker-count option; exactly 12 CPU workers
Publication is review-only and contains no TEST labels
Every artifact is replayed against checkpoint and runtime evidence
New execution requires canonical readiness from the same clean commit

nodes.label: Exp435 prediction boundary
nodes.role: Groups the frozen Exp435 configuration/contracts, descriptor-bound label-free input session, TRAIN-only feature calibration, CPU consensus scoring, candidate budget and optional MLX readiness gate.
constraints: FROZEN_CONFIG.validate() must pass before input access
Exactly 1,117 sorted unique datasets come from the frozen Exp291/292 lane population
The held Exp425 descriptor is read-only and closes on every exit path
Prediction intake exposes TRAIN values and TEST values only; no TEST labels are loaded
Exp435 TEST values are requested only after a concrete RawTrainDataset is loaded
Published records and backend evidence are immutable and fail closed on contract mismatch
Exact-length TRAIN groups retain duplicate rows and sorted instance coordinates
Invalid TRAIN groups emit immutable UnavailableTrainGroup records with preregistered reasons; valid sibling groups continue
Prototype uses TRAIN-only float32 robust scaling and leave-one-out higher-quantile calibration; gradient and ACF are optional channels
CPU scoring routes each TEST value row to one exact raw-length TRAIN group; missing or unavailable lengths abstain without concatenation or tail replacement
A candidate requires prototype AND (gradient OR ACF) with strict score > threshold; frozen-lane coordinates are excluded
Global candidate validation sorts coordinates and fails closed above 100; it never truncates or auto-promotes
MLX is optional and lazy; bundled Metal discovery, version/device provenance and runtime errors fall back to the CPU path
MLX dense scoring keeps exact float32 inputs and checks finite outputs, normalized/absolute score error <=1e-5 and exact candidate coordinates for every batch size 16, 32, 64, 128 and 256
Each MLX gate batch performs 2 warmups and 5 timed measurements including evaluation and synchronization; adoption requires speedup >=1.1
BackendBatchEvidence preserves per-batch parity, finite-output, candidate, timing and reason records; BackendDecision binds selected batch evidence to MLX/Metal/device provenance

nodes.label: Exp435 CLI + resumable runtime
nodes.role: Validates readiness and clean HEAD, runs or resumes the label-free scorer with parent-owned inputs, bounded CPU workers, ordered commits, serial adopted MLX mode, and verified publication replay.
constraints: CPU uses ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=7) with bounded prefetch 14
LaneMembershipSnapshot is immutable and pickle-safe before workers start
Parent alone owns the verified input session, checkpoint, progress and logs; commits remain dataset-name ordered
Adopted MLX uses one process and no outer scoring pool
Candidate-budget overflow is persisted before any record/publication and fails closed
Runtime outputs are bound to checkpoint path, backend, dataset total, run identity and context fingerprint
Workers receive values-only objects and never access labels, SQLite descriptors or durable outputs
Readiness has one writer and is byte-identical to the validated callback payload
A final clean-HEAD read must match both the validated HEAD and readiness commit before the input session opens
Existing publications are inspected read-only and summarized without reopening the database

nodes.label: Exp435 checkpoint + publication
nodes.role: Persists canonical records, atomic progress/PID/events logs and recovery intents, then builds and verifies a no-clobber review-only publication with prediction and manifest SHA256 evidence.
constraints: Atomic no-clobber records and record-set digest are fsynced; commit intent recovery is deterministic
Candidate budget is checked before writing an over-budget record
Only exact internal progress/PID temp files are removed on mutable resume; unknown files, symlinks and read-only pending temps fail closed
Progress, PID and events bind one canonical checkpoint path, backend, total, run identity and context fingerprint
Inspection opens no database or worker and validates outputs, events, labels firewall and counter conservation read-only
Durable progress and logs never contain TEST values or labels
Publication accepts checkpoint_complete runtime state only and requires exact success/abstention/error counter conservation
Publication staging is fsynced and moved with Darwin RENAME_EXCL so an appearing destination is never replaced
Published prediction, manifest and supporting artifacts reject forbidden TEST-label fields and are independently hash-verified

flows.label: Exp424 verified import
flows.trigger: Open the frozen Exp424 source authority.
flows.outcome: Verified nonterminal records are adapted and committed without recomputation.

flows.label: Exp426 verified intake
flows.trigger: Open the frozen Exp424 authority and stream sorted source records.
flows.outcome: 983 scored imports and 134 TRAIN-verified abstentions are produced in stable dataset order without TEST labels.

flows.label: Exp426 resumable verified baseline
flows.trigger: Start or resume the frozen Exp426 baseline population.
flows.outcome: All 1,117 records are imported or TRAIN-verified, durably checkpointed and published as complete_review_only without TEST labels.

flows.label: Exp426 independent publication replay
flows.trigger: A complete Exp426 checkpoint and terminal runtime log are available.
flows.outcome: Prediction, ledgers, backend decision, manifest, status and artifact SHA256 map are atomically published and independently reproducible.

flows.label: Exp435 resumable prediction + frozen publication
flows.trigger: The CLI validates readiness and clean HEAD, then invokes a new run, resume, inspect, or verified publication replay.
flows.outcome: The parent loads normal TRAIN first, requests values-only TEST, scores through the frozen CPU/MLX gate, durably commits ordered records, and atomically publishes hash-bound review-only artifacts without TEST labels.
